schemaVersion.description: Configuration format version. Unknown versions are rejected before writing.

performanceMode.description: Automatic CPU policy. Unknown generator backends still default to serial execution.

workers.description: Zero selects the automatic policy. Positive values set the worker ceiling.

maximumOutstandingTasks.description: Hard count limit including running, queued and obsolete work still draining.

cacheMiB.description: Accounted CPU cache budget. Zero disables admission; runtime clamps to one quarter of current maximum heap.

tileSize.description: Base tile world span in blocks. Distant zoom scales the span and sample step together.

lodSteps.description: Strictly descending powers of two no larger than tileSize, enforced by Java validation.

prefetchRings.description: At most one surrounding ring, sampled only at the coarsest resolution.

maximumViewportTiles.description: Maximum spatial tiles in a planned viewport including prefetch. Each visible tile may have several LOD passes.

uploadsPerFrame.description: Maximum tile uploads per render frame, enforced by the native client adapter.

uploadQueueMiB.description: Byte budget passed to the CPU-to-render upload queue. GPU resources have a separate native budget.

biomeColors.description: Namespaced registry IDs mapped to opaque #RRGGBB colors. Numeric registry IDs are never persisted.

biomeTagColors.description: Namespaced registry IDs mapped to opaque #RRGGBB colors. Numeric registry IDs are never persisted.

disabledIntegrations.description: Provider IDs that loader bootstrap must omit. Absence of an optional mod never loads its implementation classes.

hardware.description: Last observed JVM/GPU profile. Automatic budgets use the current machine at runtime.

logicalProcessors.description: Logical processors exposed to the JVM.

gpuVendor.description: Vendor from the version renderer, or unknown before a safe GPU probe.

gpuRenderer.description: Renderer from the version renderer, or unknown. This is not proof of compute support.
